method.scope: Two blocks, one workspace, one person. These clips informed earlier checker fixes; they are not a held-out benchmark.
method.order_caveat: The two reversed stacks change the final structure and are diagnosed as wrong placement. They do not test pure order-only errors.
method.tracking_caveat: 2D boxes support object visibility and approximate placement; they do not establish 3D contact. Partial evidence is labelled.
method.reference_caveat: The red block is named pink by the extractor. The same learned identifier is reused across attempts.

baseline.type: offline comparison of what each layer adds
baseline.final_picture_definition: Accept when every required final placement holds in the attempt's last state. Order is ignored and it never abstains.
limits: The final-picture check is our own simple comparison, written to show what order checking adds. It is not another product.
All three checks use the same saved video-model readings, so a reading error affects all of them.
These are development recordings that informed checker fixes, not a held-out benchmark.
The generated recordings come from one renderer. The phone recordings are one person, two blocks and one workspace, and contain no order-only mistake.
baseline.tracker_order_note: When a reading reports a required order, this counts whether the tracker's arrival times agree. Thresholds were chosen on these same recordings.
